description: This file contains implementation of functions and classes for creating automatic differentiation subgraphs in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including subgraph slicing, alias analysis, and gradient requirement propagation.

classes.name: WorkBlock
classes.description: A helper structure representing a range of nodes in the graph for subgraph slicing.

classes.name: SubgraphSlicer
classes.description: A class responsible for slicing, cleaning up, and managing autodiff subgraphs within a block.

classes.name: ContextMapping
classes.description: A utility class for tracking context (e.g., no_grad) information across nodes.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the subgraph slicing, unfusing aliased outputs, and cleanup procedures.

methods.name: cleanupSubgraphs
methods.description: Cleans up small or redundant subgraphs and runs common subexpression elimination.

methods.name: buildupSubgraphs
methods.description: Builds autodiff subgraphs by identifying merge opportunities and recursively processing sub-blocks.

methods.name: unfuseAliasedOutputs
methods.description: Unfuses aliased outputs in differentiable graphs to ensure correct autodiff handling.

methods.name: buildWorkBlocks
methods.description: Creates work blocks for reordering nodes during subgraph slicing based on reordering constraints.

methods.name: inlineIfTooSmall
methods.description: Inlines small differentiable subgraphs into the main graph if below a size threshold.

methods.name: sortReverseTopological
methods.description: Sorts a list of values in reverse topological order based on their nodes.

methods.name: isViewOp
methods.description: Checks if a node is a view operation that should be excluded from differentiation.

methods.name: shouldConsiderForMerge
methods.description: Determines if a node is suitable for merging into a differentiable subgraph.

methods.name: scanNode
methods.description: Scans a node to find merge opportunities and possibly create singleton subgraphs.

methods.name: tryMerge
methods.description: Attempts to merge a producer node into a consumer differentiable graph.

methods.name: getProfileNodeRequiresGrad
methods.description: Retrieves the requiresGrad attribute from a profile node if available.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Processes a node to update context stack for tracking no_grad or other contexts.

methods.name: processBlock
methods.description: Recursively processes a block to build context mapping for nodes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the context node associated with a given node.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a node has an associated context in the mapping.

methods.name: findRequiresGradForOutput
methods.description: Determines if an output requires gradient computation based on profile nodes and context.

methods.name: AddRequiresGradToDifferentiableGraph
methods.description: Propagates requiresGrad information into a differentiable graph based on profiling data.

methods.name: AddRequiresGradOnOutputNodes
methods.description: Recursively adds requiresGrad info to output nodes within a block.

methods.name: AddRequiresGradOnOutputNodes (overload)
methods.description: Entry point to add requiresGrad info to all output nodes in the graph.
